title: Spartacus Shares

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey coach.

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: I know. Guess it’s a habit. You mind if I call you that, anyway?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I know. Guess it’s a habit. You mind if I call you that, anyway?
*Sigh*. Fine.

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: Nothing. Just thinking about the match with OB4. Watched some of her old fights. She’s brutal. Rip-the-capacitor-out-your-chest-and relocate-it-to-your-tertiary-outlet brutal. I can’t beat that.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Nothing. Just thinking about the match with OB4. Watched some of her old fights. She’s brutal. Rip-the-capacitor-out-your-chest-and relocate-it-to-your-tertiary-outlet brutal. I can’t beat that.
Yeah. Shoulda known.
Right. Mean. Sure.

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: Eh. That's Bare Metal for you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Eh. That's Bare Metal for you.

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: Promise you won’t rat me out? Blow my brand?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Promise you won’t rat me out? Blow my brand?

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: Alright. Truth is, I used to be a baker. Working with dough, kneading, proofing. Takes some strength.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Alright. Truth is, I used to be a baker. Working with dough, kneading, proofing. Takes some strength.

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: I didn’t. There was this outbreak, some freak toxic fungus that killed all the wheat. Bakery went bust.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I didn’t. There was this outbreak, some freak toxic fungus that killed all the wheat. Bakery went bust.

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: Yeah. No one was hiring. I was down to my last Lims when I walked past the MechaTomb and met Floyd. He reckoned I could make it in Bare Metal. So... here I am.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah. No one was hiring. I was down to my last Lims when I walked past the MechaTomb and met Floyd. He reckoned I could make it in Bare Metal. So... here I am.

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: Some nights, when there's no one around, I’ll walk past restaurant kitchens just so I can smell the ovens. Wonder what it would be like to step back through the door.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Some nights, when there's no one around, I’ll walk past restaurant kitchens just so I can smell the ovens. Wonder what it would be like to step back through the door.

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: You know why. I can’t quit. I owe the gym for all my mods.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You know why. I can’t quit. I owe the gym for all my mods.

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: Not unless a couple hundred Lims fall out the sky. Look, I gotta get going. But thanks for listening, it was... kinda nice to remember the good times for a while.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not unless a couple hundred Lims fall out the sky. Look, I gotta get going. But thanks for listening, it was... kinda nice to remember the good times for a while.

nodes.speaker: Spartacus Doom
nodes.text: Sure. Thanks for listening. It was... kinda nice to remember the good times for a while.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure. Thanks for listening. It was... kinda nice to remember the good times for a while.
I'm not your coach.
Hi Spartacus! How's training?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Look, I'm too busy to chat right now.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look, I'm too busy to chat right now.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Look, I'm too busy to chat right now.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Look, I'm too busy to chat right now.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Sure. What's up?
What's wrong with you?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Not if you sulk like a loser. Get out there and get mean!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Not if you sulk like a loser. Get out there and get mean!
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Not if you sulk like a loser. Get out there and get mean!
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Not if you sulk like a loser. Get out there and get mean!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You shouldn't have to.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How did you get into Bare Metal Boxing anyway?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How did you get into Bare Metal Boxing anyway?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: How did you get into Bare Metal Boxing anyway?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: How did you get into Bare Metal Boxing anyway?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Go get 'em Spartacus!
Promise.
Why did you quit?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: So you were out of a job?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So you were out of a job?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: So you were out of a job?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: So you were out of a job?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you miss the bakery?
Why don't you?
I have to go now.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Isn’t there another way you could pay it back?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Isn’t there another way you could pay it back?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Isn’t there another way you could pay it back?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Isn’t there another way you could pay it back?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You stole bread rolls?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Bare Metal was your calling then?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Bare Metal was your calling then?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Bare Metal was your calling then?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Bare Metal was your calling then?
